goal: P07–P08 full narrative + lesson draft in backend/services/research_factory/.

features_delivered: P07 Long-Form Historian Narrative Drafting (P07-A01 & P07-A02): Full bilingual narrative sections in Vietnamese and English constructed strictly from verified claims in ResearchDossier.
Per-Sentence Source Binding: Every factual sentence is bound to a SentenceClaimRef linking claim_id, source_id, source_title, and locator with zero unsourced assertions.

Museum Label & Epigraphy Notes (P07-A03 & P07-A04): 80-150 word bilingual museum label with archival citations, and reviewed Hán-Nôm notes with verified glyph provenance (rejecting unreviewed glyph promotion).
3D/AR Narration with Mandatory 2D Fallback (P07-A05): Generates 3D mesh hotspot scripts while strictly requiring an authentic 2D rubbing archive fallback for low-power and non-WebGL environments.

ELLO 6-Step Historical Inquiry Lesson (P07-A07): Pedagogical lesson sequence (hook, observation, source_analysis, synthesis, reflection, evaluation) requiring students to cite primary evidence on every step.

4-Level Rubric & Source-Locked Assessment (P07-A08): 4-level rubric (0-3 criteria scale) across mastery dimensions (source literacy, evidence reasoning, contextualization) and factual quizzes locked to verified sources.
Content Bundle Assembly (P07-A10): Integrates all 9 drafting outputs into ContentBundleDraft with deterministic SHA-256 lineage and bibliography validation.

P08 Independent QA Runner (P08-A01..A10): 10 concurrent adversarial checkers inspecting sentence bindings, locators, chronology, Hán-Nôm glyphs, disputes, ELLO rubrics, quiz validity, and 2D fallbacks.
Severity Ledger & Release Gate (P08 Gate): Evaluates all findings into P0 (Blocker), P1 (Warning), and P2 (Info). Any unresolved P0 blocker strictly marks gate as GATE_BLOCKED, blocking publication.

Negative Abuse Defense - No Source -> No Invented Fact: Sentences without verified sources or novel unsupported English facts are deterministically detected as P0 blockers (UNSOURCED_FACTUAL_ASSERTION, UNSUPPORTED_EN_FACT) and trigger GATE_BLOCKED.
Database Persistence & Lineage: Persists complete P07 content bundles and P08 QA reports as immutable ResearchEvidenceResult envelopes attached to ResearchRun and ResearchPhase.
